correctness.rationale: The minimal LET_F^- semantic rule v(◦A)=1 => v(A)≠v(¬A) forces t_{i+1}=1 ⇒ t_i≠f_i. The simultaneous positive/negative structural recursion extends every compatible finite profile to a global bivaluation, including arbitrary other formula syntax. The profile count is 4×3^(k−1) and unsigned projection all 2^k assignments. Thus unsigned positive formulas are free unbounded distributive lattice D(k)−2. For signed atoms, truth sets are upsets of S_k\{0}; every nonempty upset is positive DNF and empty is realized when k≥2 by a0∧¬a0∧a1; k=1 exceptional four classes. Separate independent exact bitset-antichain recursion gives 83 upsets at k=2 and 70,806 at k=3, with profile counts through k=7.
